what: Per-entry store cost of a Valkey 8 stream entry, measured to validate the audit byte model.
why: rc3-audit-mem-v1 models payload x 1.10 + 256 B and its README states the model was above the real cost at every sampled size. It was, for the sizes it sampled. This re-measurement across a wider range shows the ratio oscillates with the allocator's size classes, so 1.10 UNDER-charges at 2 KB, 4 KB and 8 KB. An under-charging model derives a MAXLEN that is too long, so the store fills while every gauge reports the bound being honoured.
method: Private valkey/valkey:8-alpine, 512 MB maxmemory, noeviction. 2,000 entries per size via the real ValkeyAuditStore.append. used_memory delta from INFO memory; MEMORY USAGE on the stream key. Divided by entry count.
headroom_at_worst_point: 1.10x (11315 B charged vs 10267 B measured at 8192 B payload)
note: The reference sampled 2,900 B and 6,000 B, which are two of the cheap points (ratio 1.07 and 1.03). The three expensive points land just above an allocator size class.
